title: fix(service-settings): translate Data Lifecycle settings; AI & Knowledge help in business words
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Fixes #28064
Fixes #28069

## What changes

### #28064: the Data Lifecycle settings page is translated

- `settings.lifecycle` is added to the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES files of `settingsBuiltinTranslations` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/`). It covers the title, the description, and each key's label and help (`enabled`, `retention_overrides`, `quotas`, `quota_defaults`, `growth_alert_rows`).
  - The titles match the Setup sidebar entry (`数据生命周期` / `データライフサイクル` / `Ciclo de vida de los datos`).
  - The field terms follow the object lifecycle forms already shipped (保留期 / 保持期間 / retención, 生命周期类别 / ライフサイクルクラス / clase de ciclo de vida).
  - JSON examples inside the help stay as written.
  - `en` keeps falling back to the manifest literals, as it does for `sms`.
- **The coverage test declares the lifecycle namespace instead of refusing it.** `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` now checks every manifest whose copy this bundle carries: the bundled manifests plus a named list of *hosted* platform manifests.
  - A hosted manifest is one that another package registers into the same hub and that ships no bundle of its own. Today the list holds objectql's `lifecycleSettingsManifest`.
  - A hosted manifest gets the same full coverage check as a bundled one, and its namespace counts as declared for the no-undeclared-copy check.
  - A new test pins that the list contains `lifecycle` and that no namespace is declared twice.
- **The parity pin loses its exception.** `setup-nav-hub-parity.test.ts` drops `HUB_UNTRANSLATED`. Its per-locale test is now "every hub page carries a translated title", so the sidebar-vs-hub label comparison also runs for Data Lifecycle.
- The `translations/index.ts` docblock names the hosted namespace.

### #28069: AI & Embedder and Knowledge help is in business words

This applies the treatment #28063 gave Authentication / Feature Flags / Mail. The manifest literals (the English fallback) and the en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES packs change together:

- **API keys and gateway model.** The OpenAI / Anthropic / Google API keys and the gateway model read "used instead of the key (model) set in the server configuration". Before, they read "Forwarded as `OPENAI_API_KEY`" (and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY`, `AI_GATEWAY_MODEL`). The settings manifest has no per-field docs-link slot, so, as in #28063, the env var names leave the help entirely. They stay in the code comment beside the Reset action and in the deployment docs.
- **Record traces** says it keeps a record of each AI request and its response, so a conversation can be inspected and replayed. It no longer names `sys_ai_trace`.
- **Batch size** is "chunks sent to the embedding provider in one request". It no longer says `embed()`.
- **Knowledge help:**
  - Indexing defaults: "a value set on a knowledge source itself wins over these defaults" (no `KnowledgeSource.adapterConfig`).
  - Over-fetch multiplier is described by its effect (no `topK × overFetch`, no "JS-side").
  - The RAGFlow default dataset says "knowledge source".
  - The Turso group no longer says "tenant's primary libSQL connection".
  - Enforce RLS on search no longer names `IDataEngine` (manifest and zh-CN).
- Code spans around model examples (`provider/model`, `openai/gpt-4o`, `default`) become plain text or quotes. The examples stay, because they are what the administrator types.
- `settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts` now sweeps `ai` and `knowledge` as well as `auth`, `feature_flags` and `mail`. It adds teeth cases for the strings #28069 was filed for, plus a negative case showing that model examples are not flagged.

No key, default, option or validation changes in either part. `packages/objectql` is untouched. There are two `patch` changesets for `@objectstack/service-settings`.

## Why

**#28064:** Setup → All Settings → Data Lifecycle read English under zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES: the card title, its description and every field. Every other settings page and the sidebar entry for this page were translated.

- The page comes from objectql's `lifecycleSettingsManifest`, and no bundle carried `settings.lifecycle.*`.
- The built-in settings bundle is where every other settings page's copy lives, but its coverage test refused any namespace that no bundled manifest declares.
- This PR widens that rule by naming the manifest, not by adding a bare exception.

**#28069:** the help under AI & Embedder and Knowledge read like code comments in all four languages. It named env vars, the trace object, a code call and a config path that an administrator can neither see nor change from this page. Triage ruled that the help says what the setting does in business words. It is the remainder of #27521 row 2, whose other pages #28063 fixed.

## Verification

All readings are against the worktree at `origin/main` `8cb8c7f4` plus the two commits (`273efdc1`, `b4c0a258`).

| Check | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `setup-nav-hub-parity.test.ts` with the exception list emptied | **3 failed** / 6 passed (9): zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES each `expected [ 'lifecycle' ] to deeply equal []` | 9 / 9 passed |
| `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`, new test with the lifecycle entries removed | n/a | **3 failed** / 41 passed (44): `zh-CN/ja-JP/es-ES covers settings.lifecycle` |
| Old coverage test with the new lifecycle entries | **3 failed** / 37 passed (40): undeclared `namespace:lifecycle` | n/a (rule replaced) |
| `settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts` sweeping `ai` and `knowledge`, against the old help | **10 failed** / 20 passed (30): the manifest and all four packs, for both namespaces, e.g. `ai.keys.openai_api_key.help → env var or error code: OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ai.trace_enabled.description → … sys_ai_trace`, `knowledge.indexing.description → camelCase code identifier: adapterConfig` | 30 / 30 passed |
| `@objectstack/service-settings` `pnpm test` | n/a | 65 files, 1076 / 1076 passed |
| `@objectstack/service-settings` `pnpm typecheck` | n/a | exit 0 |
| eslint on the changed `.ts` files | n/a | exit 0 |
| `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` | n/a | all exit 0 |
| `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` | n/a | exit 0 (2 commits) |

No test outside `service-settings` pinned the old AI or Knowledge help: `git grep` for each replaced phrase finds only released `CHANGELOG.md` entries.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：
  - #28064：在内置设置翻译包的 zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES 中补上「数据生命周期」页（`settings.lifecycle`）的标题、描述和 5 个字段的 label 与 help。覆盖测试把 objectql 的 `lifecycleSettingsManifest` 列为“托管清单”，纳入同一覆盖规则。对齐测试删除 `HUB_UNTRANSLATED`。
  - #28069：「AI 与嵌入」和「知识库」的帮助文字改成业务用语（清单与四个语言包同步），不再出现环境变量名、`sys_ai_trace`、`embed()`、`KnowledgeSource.adapterConfig`、`topK × overFetch`。业务用语钉子测试扩展到这两个命名空间。
- **为什么改**：
  - 数据生命周期页在三种语言下全是英文，侧栏条目却已翻译，两边不一致。
  - AI 与知识库的帮助像代码注释，管理员看不懂，也无法在这里改动。分诊裁定按 #28063 的做法改成业务用语。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改翻译数据、帮助文字和测试，没有改键名、默认值或校验，也没动 objectql。每张卡对应一个提交，可以分别 revert。
- **先看**：
  - `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` 的 `hostedManifests`（规则是否合理）。
  - `manifests/ai.manifest.ts` 中 API Key 的新说法「用于代替服务器配置中设定的密钥」。
  - `settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts` 新增的命名空间与 teeth 用例。
- **亲手验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`。或者把控制台切到中文、日文或西班牙文，打开 设置 → 数据生命周期 / AI / 知识库，看标题与帮助。
- **需要你做的**：
  - 分诊原话是把环境变量名移到“面向开发者”的一行，但 #28063 的钉子测试禁止帮助中出现任何环境变量名，清单也没有逐字段的文档链接位，所以这里按 #28063 的做法整句去掉。请确认这样可以接受。
  - 确认把托管清单的译文放在 service-settings 包里可以接受。
